liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Jack Straw** (1 review): Phil went absolutely nuts during the performance of this song [43]
- **West L.A. Fadeaway** (1 review): Listener realized the performance was recent upon hearing this specific track [39]
- **Crazy Fingers** (1 review): Transition into Playing in the Band highlighted as a standout pre-drums moment [42]
- **Morning Dew** (1 review): Listener cites this song as the primary reason for returning to the recording [42]

## The recordings

- **gd1988-07-02.mtx-v2.haugh.92583.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 163 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1988-07-02.145666.fob.akg460.ackerman.miller.noel.t-flac16**: audience recording; 22 songs; 160 min [3]
- **gd1988-07-02.156917.nak700.werner.flac1644**: source not stated; 23 songs; 164 min [5]. Said about its sound: Bass levels in Terrapin Station and Morning Dew are very loud and potentially damaging [5]
- **gd88-07-02.DTS.matrix.dan.21434.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 156 min; rated 4.5/5 by 10 [15]. Said about its sound: Source is intended exclusively for full five-speaker 5.1 digital surround sound systems; Phil's vocals were slightly loud, requiring the user to lower the subwoofer [45][47]
- **gd88-07-02.sbd-matrix.dan.21211.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 156 min; rated 4.19/5 by 72 [16]. Said about its sound: Drums and Space sections are cut short on this specific matrix recording [48]

## Around the show

- Attendee describes the weather as beautiful and the band as tight and great [40]
- Little Feat opened both nights at the Oxford venue [43]
